data.title: Casa Canal Interiors by Fendi Casa
data.about:
Casa Canal Interiors by Fendi Casa is a stunning boat-like structure along the vibrant Dubai Water Canal. A collaborative venture of Fendi Casa and AHS Properties, the exceptional branded residence showcases an exclusive collection of 3-bedroom penthouses, 4 and 5-bedroom Sky Villas, 6-Bedroom Sky Mansions, and three Sky Palace. Immerse yourself in the epitome of luxury living, where high-end design meets unparalleled convenience, all within the picturesque surroundings of the canal and Safa Park.

Designed by Fendi Casa Interiors, the tower presents a stunning array of homes ranging from 4,500 sq. ft. to 30,000 sq. ft. Experience a five-star concierge’s unparalleled comfort and convenience, including Chauffeured Limo Service, a cigar lounge, and a world-class fine dining experience.

characteristics_module.title: An array of accommodation choices, breathtaking views and hotel-like amenities.
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Enjoy waterfront views of the Dubai Water Canal and Safa Park.
  • Facilities like chauffeur service, infinity pool, cigar lounge and yoga studio.
  • Located near the famous Water Canal.
  • Attractive and flexible payment plan options are available.
  • Promising luxury living at its finest, it offers a remarkable selection of 3-bedroom penthouses, 4 and 5-bedroom sky villas, 6-bedroom sky mansions, and three Sky Palace.
  • Casa Canal is in the city's heart and provides residents unparalleled convenience and accessibility.
  • Private elevators that open directly into your residence.

location_tile.title: Ideal location with an array of amenities nearby
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
Casa Canal is perfectly positioned along the picturesque banks of the Dubai Water Canal. This prime location offers residents awe-inspiring views of the iconic Dubai skyline while providing effortless access to nearby landmarks and attractions.

Dubai Water Canal presents an array of attractions and activities suitable for residents and tourists. The scenic waterfront promenade is ideal for leisurely walks, jogging, or cycling, surrounded by verdant landscapes and breathtaking city skyline vistas. Adjacent to the canal, an assortment of dining establishments awaits, ranging from elegant restaurants to chic cafes, each providing a unique culinary journey against the sparkling waterscape.

  • 3 minutes to Safa Park
  • 4 minutes to City Walk
  • 5 minutes to Jumeirah Beach
  • 6 minutes to Downtown Dubai
  • 7 minutes to Dubai Mall
  • 8 minutes to DIFC (Dubai International Financial Centre)
  • 10 minutes to Business Bay
  • 12 minutes to Dubai Opera
